answer: Lock a newcomer's earnings in a vault for twelve epochs instead of paying out. First, every reward a new identity earns stays locked until it finishes twelve straight epochs of honest, attested work. Second, one failed audit resets the clock to zero. Third, peers randomly audit one in eight vaulted identities each epoch, and a caught fake forfeits its whole vault to the honest pool. Running 1,000 sybils means parking about 240,000 dollars of earnings for a year. Each honest epoch adds another turn to the spiral, and the delta between a real worker and a fake keeps widening.
